description.text:
An expansion pack released on 22 October 2021 for the 25th anniversary of the Pokémon Card Game. Every card is holo and bears a 25th anniversary mark, and packs held five cards, one of them a basic Energy. It gathers legendary Pokémon from every series, from Ho-Oh and Lugia to Solgaleo, Lunala, Zacian V and Zamazenta V, with Cosmog and Cosmoem drawn beside Lillie, and Pikachu in many guises: a Pikachu recreating its illustration from the first expansion pack of 1996, Pikachu V, Surfing Pikachu and Flying Pikachu as Pokémon V and VMAX, and Pikachu V-UNION, four cards that join into one picture of 25 Pikachu, each drawn by a different illustrator. Professor's Research shows Professor Oak. The cards are numbered to 28, followed by a full-art Super Rare Professor's Research and a gold Ultra Rare Mew. In English many of its cards came out in Celebrations in October 2021, a set for the same anniversary.

Buying four packs earned a Promo Card Pack 25th ANNIVERSARY edition, holding one of 25 cards that recreate famous cards of the past, such as Imposter Professor Oak from the first expansion pack, Shining Magikarp, M Rayquaza-EX and Tapu Lele-GX. Those recreations can't be used in official tournaments.
